metadata.description: Skills, agents and extensions for GitHub Copilot CLI (the Claude Code marketplace is .claude-plugin/marketplace.json).

plugins.name: m365
plugins.description: /m365: ask Microsoft 365 Copilot from the session through UI Automation, with the conversation so far, response profiles (fixed instructions, JSON answers) and text files attached; /m365-raw sends the question alone. No model call on the Copilot CLI side. Windows only.
